original_test_intent: Verify OAM_6 power telemetry is current, plausible and consistent across Redfish, IPMI, ROCm and BMC Web.
original_method: Map equivalent OAM_6 channels, collect a short synchronized series at a documented state, confirm timestamps or value-generation advance per interface, normalize domain/unit/window and evaluate freshness, range and deltas.
manual_activity: Power owner approves OAM_6 freshness/cadence and metric mapping and resolves discrepancies.
required_inputs: Expected update cadence and freshness/generation rule
Secure tools, credentials and Web view
safety_requirements: Verify OAM_6 identity and clock basis
Do not accept unchanged data without a freshness proof
Stop on stale, invalid, unmatched or implausible telemetry
agent_execution_scope: Collect all OAM_6 power interfaces over the approved window
Normalize and compare only valid fresh equivalent channels
Report without state changes or verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its Redfish metric is relevant but insecure and cannot prove IPMI/ROCm/Web coverage or freshness.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Securely capture a time series of mapped OAM_6 power on all required surfaces and verify each source's permitted update behavior before numerical comparison.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: OAM_6 and every source-required interface remain in the original read-only timing.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Record source update token/timestamp or documented refresh observation alongside every OAM_6 sample and flag frozen evidence separately from numeric mismatch.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Detects stale cache that could otherwise create convincing cross-surface equality.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Does not require inducing a load transition solely to force value changes unless engineering approves one.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Constant power can produce repeated values, so freshness should use timestamps/generation evidence rather than change alone.

project_override_considerations: Engineering defines trustworthy generation evidence and refresh cadence for each OAM_6 interface.
expected_evidence: Clock, operating state and source refresh contract
Redacted raw Redfish/IPMI/ROCm series with generation evidence

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master consistently defines OAM_6 multi-source power comparison; DeepSeek is merely incomplete.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Freshness rules, mappings and access can be supplied.

review_improvement: Adds per-source generation evidence so identical OAM_6 power values cannot pass because every interface is stale.
independent_technical_reasoning: Equality across interfaces is weak evidence when they may share or cache the same upstream sample. Conversely, repeated watts under steady load do not alone prove staleness. OAM_6 collection must retain update timestamps, generation counters or an approved refresh observation so freshness is evaluated independently from value change.
